cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Předmět navazuje na předmět GIS a rozšiřuje znalosti problematiky GIS a DPZ jak v teoretické, tak praktické rovině se zaměřením aplikaci GIS a DPZ v krajinném inženýrství.Kromě různých analýz na úrovni krajiny jsou řešeny rovněž základní i pokročilé způsoby zpracování prostorových dat a klasifikace obrazových dat DPZ.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Basic and advanced knowledge of GIS and Remote Sensing both in theoretical and practical level especially focused on aplications in lanscape engineering. Advanced methods of digital spatial data analysis and classifications of remote sensing data.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Geografic Information Systems (allowance 10/12) a.a) GIS - conception, function, components, GIS applicationsb) Spatial geodata - features (location, attributes, topology), coordinate systems c) Spatial datasources for Czech Republicd) Interpolations, spatial distibution, methodse) Digital elevation models - raster models x TINf) Spatial Decision Support Systems - conception, definition, components, applicationsg) Fotogrammetry, UAV - Unmanned Airborne Vehiclesh) LiDAR - Airborne Laser Scanning, Terrestrial Laser Scanning, Mobile Laser Scanningi) GNSS -- Global Navigation Satellite Systems2.Remote Sensing (allowance 10/8) a.a) Remote Sensing - basic principles, interactions with atmosphere, active x passive recordingb) Electromagnetic radiation - spectrum, wavelengthsc) Analog x digital images, features - spatial, spectral, radiometric and temporal resolution.d) Multispectral, superspectral, hyperspectral images and its utilizatione) Airborne x satellite imaging f) Image classifications

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Completion by credit and examination. In addition to attendance in the exercises, participation in the field course and submission of protocols from individual exercises is a condition for obtaining credit. The oral examination will focus on the student's ability to theoretically master the issues of GIS and Remote Sensing.
